description: The Graphalytics scorecard ladder (#952, #1903): wiki-Talk, cit-Patents, datagen-7_5-fb and graph500-22 from the pinned LDBC archives. BFS, WCC, undirected LCC and SSSP run through the public analyst verbs on the durable project; every run is checked against the archive's own reference outputs with the Graphalytics matching rules.
variance_line: Graphalytics algorithms run through GraphForge analyst verbs; PR, CDLP and directed LCC are refused and makespan is not measured.
attribution: Datasets, reference outputs and specification from LDBC Graphalytics (https://ldbcouncil.org/benchmarks/graphalytics/); LDBC materials are used under CC-BY 4.0.

variances.subject: Tp
variances.text: Tp is the driver clock around one analyst-verb call that returns a materialized Arrow result: paths(by=bfs|dijkstra) also builds each reached vertex's path, and rank and cluster return each vertex's properties. Graphalytics Tp excludes producing output.

variances.subject: runs
variances.text: Each algorithm runs once as an excluded warm-up, then three measured runs in one warm process on the reopened project; Tp is their mean and every run is checked.

variances.subject: BFS, SSSP
variances.text: paths returns only reached vertices, so a vertex the reference marks unreachable (9223372036854775807 or infinity) matches by its absence; every reference output must list every vertex exactly once.

variances.subject: timeouts
variances.text: Graphalytics' per-class job time-outs are not applied; each rung runs under the four-hour rung wall.
